name: race-planner
description: Race strategy planner for triathlon and marathon

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @race-planner/backend
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @race-planner/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @race-planner/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
